name: elevenlabs-mcp
description: ElevenLabs (builder tools): me, list_items, get_item, delete_item. Every tool maps to a documented e

platform_mcp_elevenlabs_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
platform_mcp_elevenlabs_api_key.description: ElevenLabs API key (Profile > API Keys; scoped keys need voices read/write for these tools), sent as the xi-api-key header.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v1/user: user id, subscription tier, character count/limit.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: GET /v2/voices?page_size (≤100)&next_page_token&search&voice_type: the account's voices (items are voices; collection = voice_type such as personal, community, default, workspace). Cursor-paginated: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: GET /v1/voices/{voice_id}: one voice with its settings, labels and samples (in raw).

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: DELETE /v1/voices/{voice_id} -> {status: ok}: permanently deletes a voice the account owns.
